files.description: What of the release goes into the backup.

keep.description: How many releases stay on the server.

BackupFiles.description: Paths in the release, in the syntax of `pipeline.pack.files`. The release's own `release.json` and service file are always in; `service.shared` folders never are.

deployed.description: The files shipdeck shipped: the binary and what `pipeline.pack.files` picked. Default: true.

exclude.description: What to leave out, shipped or not. A folder leaves out everything in it; `"!pattern"` keeps what it matches.

include.description: More from the release, such as a file setup made that it cannot make again. A folder brings everything in it; `"!pattern"` leaves out what it matches.

run.description: Builds the project on your PC, in `project`.

version_from.description: The file whose version names the release, relative to `project`: Cargo.toml, package.json, pyproject.toml, or any file whose first line is the version. Default: the first of those in `project`, else the latest git tag.

Commands.description: One shell command, or a list run in order that stops at the first failure.

rollback.description: What happens when the switch, the restart or the health check fails: put back the release that was live before. Default: ask.

run.description: Runs on your PC, in `project`. The server may be out of reach when a step fails, so there is no `server` here.

Files.description: Paths or globs, fast-glob and Tailwind style: `*` and `?` inside one folder, `**/` for any number of folders, `[a-z]`, `{js,ts}`. A pattern starting with `!` turns it around. `.git` is never shipped.

exclude.description: What to leave out of `include`. A folder leaves out everything in it; `"!pattern"` keeps what it matches.

include.description: What to ship. A folder brings everything in it; `"!pattern"` leaves out what it matches.

check.description: Commands that must pass: `server` in `current`, then `local` in `project`. Retried until `timeout_secs`.

timeout_secs.description: Seconds the release has to become healthy. Default: 20.

url.description: Fetched on the server with curl or wget; it must answer 2xx. Such as `http://127.0.0.1:3000/health`.

Keep.description: Old releases kept on the server, for rollback.

compressed.description: Older releases kept only as their backup in `backups/`. 0 keeps none, and then no backup is made. Default: 15.

open.description: Releases kept unpacked and ready to switch to, counting the live one. Default: 5.

Manager.description: What keeps the app running on the server.

oneOf.description: A systemd unit, installed and restarted with sudo.
PM2, run as the SSH user: no sudo. Reloaded with `pm2 startOrReload`, then saved with `pm2 save`.

binary.description: A compiled program, relative to `project`. It lands at the release root and is checked against the server's CPU and glibc.

files.description: Files and folders to put in the release, each at its own path.

Pipeline.description: The steps of a deploy that take settings.

backup.description: Step 7: shipdeck packs the set-up release into `backups/<id>.tar.zst`, which stays when the release folder goes. A rollback to it unpacks it and runs setup again, so what setup makes, such as node_modules, can stay out. A failure removes the new release.

build.description: Step 2. Runs `run.local` in `project`. A failure stops the deploy.

done.description: Step 11: the new release is live. shipdeck tidies old releases (see `backup.keep`), then runs `run.server` in `current`, then `run.local`. A failure is only a warning. A manual rollback runs it too, with SHIPDECK_ACTION=rollback.

failed.description: Runs when any step fails, after a rollback if there was one. SHIPDECK_STEP names the step that failed.

health.description: Step 10, after shipdeck switches `current` and restarts the service. Waits until the service is active, `url` answers and every check passes; when it does not, see `failed.rollback`.

pack.description: Step 3. What goes into the release: the binary and the files.

preflight.description: Step 1. shipdeck checks your PC and the server, then runs `run.server` in `service.dir`, then `run.local` in `project`. A failure stops the deploy before anything is built.

setup.description: Step 6, after shipdeck uploads and unpacks the release. Runs in `releases/<id>` on the server while the old release is still live: `run.server`, then `check.server`. A failure removes the new release.

Pm2.description: How PM2 runs the app. Either shipdeck writes the app file from `service.start`, `service.env` and `options`, or `ecosystem` names your own.

app.description: The app's name in PM2, as `pm2 list` shows it. Default: `service.name`.

ecosystem.description: Your own PM2 file in the release, such as `ecosystem.config.js`. shipdeck reloads the app `app` from it; `service.start` and `options` are not used. Ship it with `pipeline.pack.files`.

options.description: More PM2 app settings for the file shipdeck writes, such as `instances: max`, `exec_mode: cluster` or `max_memory_restart: 300M`. shipdeck sets `name`, `cwd` and the environment itself.

requires.description: Programs the server must have, such as `node` or `npm`. Preflight stops if one is missing.

oneOf.description: Ask before rolling back to the release that was live. With no answer within 30 seconds, roll back.

Service.description: The service shipdeck runs, and where its releases live.

dir.description: An absolute folder on the server, such as `/opt/my-api`. It holds `current` (the live release), `releases/`, `backups/` and `shared/`.

env.description: Environment variables for the service and for server commands.

env_file.description: A `KEY=value` file in the release, such as `.env`. The service gets it as its environment, and server commands load it too.

manager.description: What keeps the app running: `systemd`, a unit shipdeck installs with sudo, or `pm2`, run as the SSH user without sudo. Default: systemd.

name.description: The unit's name without `.service`: `my-api` becomes my-api.service. With PM2, also the app's name unless `pm2.app` is set.

pm2.description: How PM2 runs the app, with `manager: pm2`.

run_as.description: The user the service runs as. Default: the SSH user. PM2 always runs the app as the SSH user.

shared.description: Folders kept across releases, such as `uploads`. Each lives in `shared/` and is linked into every release.

start.description: The command the service runs, from the release folder: `./my-api -E=.env` or `node dist/main.js`. A bare program name such as `node` is looked up on the server. Default: `./<binary>` from `pipeline.pack.binary`.

check.description: Commands that must pass after `run`, such as `node --check dist/main.js`.

run.description: Commands in the new release on the server, such as `npm ci --omit=dev` or migrations.

Sources.description: Each path keeps its place inside the release.

deploy.description: Relative to this deploy.yaml's folder, for files that belong to this deployment, such as `.env`. A file here replaces a project file at the same path.

project.description: Relative to `project`, such as `dist` or `"src/**/*.{js,json}"`. `.` is the whole project.

SshTarget.description: How to log in. `host` may be an alias from `~/.ssh/config`; `port` and `user` then come from it unless set here.

host.description: The server's address, or an alias from `~/.ssh/config`.

shell_env.description: Give server commands the environment a terminal has: shipdeck starts the login shell once per connection, so `~/.bashrc`, `~/.zshrc` or `config.fish` set up PATH (nvm and the like). Default: true.

user.description: The user shipdeck logs in and deploys as. Default: the alias's User.

description: One deployable: what it is, where it runs, and the pipeline that ships it.

name.description: The name shipdeck shows, such as `My API (prod)`. Also the systemd unit's description.

pipeline.description: The steps of a deploy, in order: preflight, build, pack, setup, backup, health, done, and failed when a step fails. upload, unpack, switch and restart are done by shipdeck and take no settings.

project.description: Your source folder, relative to this deploy.yaml. Local commands run here, and `pipeline.pack` takes project files from here. Default: the folder of this deploy.yaml.

service.description: The service on the server (a systemd unit or a PM2 app), and where its releases live.

ssh.description: How to log in to the server.

title: shipdeck deploy.yaml
